heading_en: Notification of Trading Desks by Ultimate Designated Parent Companies Adopting the Standardized Method
summary_ja: 標準的方式採用最終指定親会社が標準的方式を用いるトレーディング・デスクを設置する際の届出事項と添付書類を定める。
summary_en: Sets the advance notification and attachments for an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized method that establishes trading desks.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized method shall, when it intends to establish a trading desk that uses the standardized method, submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency in advance a notification stating the following matters. (i) Trade name. (ii) The name and title of the person responsible for managing the trading desk.

The following documents shall be attached to the notification under the preceding paragraph. (i) A curriculum vitae of the person responsible prescribed in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (ii) A document showing that each trading desk satisfies the requirements listed in the items of Article 249-3, paragraph (3) (excluding item (x)(b)). (iii) A document stating other matters that should be used for reference.
